reviews.comment:
Pésima atención. Viajé solo con mi perro, llegué a esa ypf con sed y hambre, entro con él a upa y no me quisieron vender ( mi perro es un salchicha mini, entra en una mano). Les dije que solo compraba y me iba y me dijeron que NO, que dejara al perro en el auto con el calor que hace. Son unos insensibles y discriminadores. Si tienen perros no vayan!!!!!!!!!

(Translated by Google)
Terrible service. I was traveling alone with my dog, and I arrived at that YPF gas station thirsty and hungry. I went in with him in my arms, and they refused to sell to me (my dog ​​is a miniature dachshund, he fits in the palm of my hand). I told them I was just going to buy something and leave, and they said NO, that I had to leave the dog in the car in this heat. They are insensitive and discriminatory. If you have dogs, don't go there!!!!!!!!!
reviews.name: accounts/109853746269412609224/locations/2813003656748655180/reviews/ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmcUp2dkl3EAE
